comparison.objective: Recover a drawer jammed by a clothing proxy; candidate transfers an uncaged LM block onto a jig.
comparison.physical_skill: Record holds/pulls a drawer while compressing an obstruction, then resumes opening. Candidate keeps rigid support profiles flush and parallel while sliding a ball-circulating block across them.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires ordered jam, compression, clearance and full opening milestones. Candidate requires full transfer with every free ball contained and no support separation, jam, impact or contamination.
comparison.reason: Obstruction recovery and clothing-proxy compression do not test precision support continuity for loose rolling elements. The record explicitly lacks comprehensive force/damage compliance, but that omission does not create plausible duplication.
